rationale: At 03:00 ET London cash opens and European desks put on the day's first real positions, the first minutes set a range, and a 5-minute close outside it shows which side Europe accepted, which the rest of the European morning tends to follow (a screen held to 15:58, the real London rule is flat by 09:25). Losing side: Overnight range traders who fade the first accepted move after the London open.
notes: win_break: the range of the 1-minute bars in [r_start, r_end) (any window of the day) is broken by a tf bar's CLOSE after r_end -> a market entry with the break (follow) or against it (fade), or a limit at the broken edge (retest); one trade a session in the pass of the break
